answer.original_source: Sharon AI, in an 8-K filing dated 2026-06-12; Tom's Hardware reported the filing on 2026-07-02.
answer.new_information: Sharon AI disclosed a six-year agreement covering 72 MW of new Australian data-center capacity built to Nvidia's DSX AI factory design, scaling to as many as 40,000 Grace Blackwell GB300 GPUs. The 40,000-GPU maximum repeats the capacity claim in e9 and e26. The filing excerpt does not specify Nvidia backstop or credit-support obligations, a commitment amount, or a revenue-share percentage. Its six-year term is not a stated FY2027 reporting period, and the stated capacity is not itself a measure of Nvidia's financial commitments.
answer.reason: This adds company-filed detail on Sharon AI's deployment agreement, but the record does not establish that the agreement creates a Nvidia financial commitment within v3's definition or quantify one. It therefore supplies context without moving the estimate of commitments to be reported at the FY2027 annual filing. Sharon AI is also the original source of the overlapping 40,000-GPU claim in e26, so the incoming record is not an independent source for that claim.
